import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
# worst-case output size: 64-long CNAME chain of maximal names + 64-record terminal RRset
def nm(i):
    lbl=''.join('ab'[(i>>(k))&1] for k in range(7))*4   # 28 chars
    return '.'.join(['a'*62]*4+[lbl])+'.'
assert sum(len(l)+1 for l in nm(0)[:-1].split('.'))+1 <= 255, sum(len(l)+1 for l in nm(0)[:-1].split('.'))+1
recs=[{'owner':nm(i),'type':'CNAME','data':nm(i+1)} for i in range(64)]
recs+= [{'owner':nm(64),'type':'A','data':'192.0.2.%d'%j} for j in range(1,65)]
doc={'zones':[{'origin':'.','records':recs}],
     'profiles':[{'id':'p%d'%i,'max_aliases':64,'cname':'follow','wildcard':'rfc'} for i in range(8)],
     'queries':[{'id':'q%d'%i,'name':nm(0),'type':'A','cost':1} for i in range(20)],'observations':[]}
raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
print('bytes',len(raw))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
print('elapsed %.2f'%(time.time()-t),'rc',p.returncode,'outlen %.1f MiB'%(len(p.stdout)/1048576))
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
r=out['runs'][0]
print('records in answer',len(r['answer']),'trace',len(r['trace']),r['termination'],r['rcode'])
print('distinct profiles equal?', all(out['runs'][i]['answer']==out['runs'][0]['answer'] for i in range(8)))
PYEOF
